title: The thirtieth flyer, close
logline: The thirtieth flyer close, three weeks pinned, the crab in its corner in the girl's hand, and beside it in pencil, tiny, a second crab in another hand — the boy's. Two crabs. The 2002 flyer had two as well. The page doesn't say that.

panels.composition: Close on a paper flyer pinned to shingle with a small ink crab in one corner and a tinier pencil crab beside it in a different hand.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a paper flyer pinned to a shingle wall with a small ink crab in one corner and a tinier pencil crab beside it in a different hand, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
